name: @rello-platform/ad-platforms
description: Ad-platform HTTP clients for the Rello platform: Meta Conversions API and Custom Audiences, Google Data Manager conversions and Customer Match, the Drumbeat's moved Meta and Google Ads API audience clients, per-platform normalization and SHA-256, RFC 8785 frozen batches, and a local fake server. No credentials, no tenant data, no Prisma.
comment:exports: Single-format ESM, the tracking/slugs precedent: the same ESM file under import/require/default so a CJS consumer on Node >=22 (require(esm)) cannot hit ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. ./fake is the local fake ad server for consumers' tests.

scripts.test: npm run compile && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && vitest run
